_help: (design §GO.10, queue 125, Claude Code; first guesses for Mike to tune) The bard and the oracle, one of each in every realm, both mute (§ED): they never speak; the log says only what they do. Only the desert is built, so only the desert has them yet (realms.first); the stand-in realms get theirs when they are built.
_help_bard: The bard sits by the realm's ruin (from_mouth_m from its mouth) playing their instrument on a loop, heard far off: full at ref_m, falling off with distance (inverse distance, from base_db), silent past hear_m. Follow it in. Interact within reach_m and they teach you the instrument as a technique (saved, kept through death and save-and-quit). Its material lies beside them (material_m off): take some, set it down in the camp store, and the maker builds the instrument; one of the keepers then plays it at the evening meal.

bard.log_learn: The bard plays the phrase again, slower, and puts the {name} in your hands until your fingers find it.
bard.log_known: The bard plays on. You already know the {name}.

_help_oracle: The oracle meditates somewhere secluded, with nothing pointing the way: no sound, no light, never within the bard's hearing (bard.hear_m + clear_of_bard_m), at least from_hearth_m from the realm's hearth, off_path_m off the line from the hearth to the ruin, toward the realm's edge (edge_share of the way out at least). (Doors home, §GK.5, are not built yet; when they are the oracle keeps clear of them too.) Interact within reach_m: a brief vision (vision_s, a still in smoke; placeholder art) and they hand you the realm's sacred text for your library.

oracle.log_text: The oracle opens their eyes, and presses a book into your hands: the {title}.

_help_realms: Per realm (crawler.json areas key): its bard's instrument and its oracle's text (library.json texts).
_help_instruments: Each instrument: name, material (a haul key: hub_work.json bring, stocks_band), made_by (the keeper who builds it), work_min, player (the keeper who plays it at the evening meal), tune (the loop: root_hz, bpm, notes in semitones above the root, null a rest; a breathy flute voice). Desert first guess: a clay ocarina of the desert's red clay, made by the knapper-potter, played by the fisher-weaver.
